description: Bitcrusher and decimator side by side, each built on a sample and hold, each with its own dry/wet mix and voltage control

params.text: Sets the depth of the bitcrushing
Sets the depth of the decimation by setting the rate of the internal oscillator that samples the signal
Crossfades between the unprocessed signal and the bitcrushed signal, in a straight line rather than an equal-power curve
Crossfades between the unprocessed signal and the decimated signal, in a straight line rather than an equal-power curve
Attenuates and inverts the bitcrusher's depth CV input
Attenuates and inverts the decimator's depth CV input, and fully counter-clockwise the decimator's sampling oscillator tracks that input at one volt per octave
Attenuates and inverts the CV input for the bitcrusher's dry and wet balance
Attenuates and inverts the CV input for the decimator's dry and wet balance

inputs.text: The audio input to the bitcrusher
The audio input to the decimator; with nothing patched here it takes the bitcrusher's output
Modulates the depth of the bitcrushing, scaled by the attenuverter for it
Modulates the depth of the decimation, scaled by the attenuverter for it
Modulates the dry and wet balance of the bitcrusher, scaled by the attenuverter for it
Modulates the dry and wet balance of the decimator, scaled by the attenuverter for it
A trigger steps the bitcrusher's sample and hold; it is combined with the bitcrusher's own internal trigger, so feeding the input signal in here forces a static waveform
A trigger samples the decimator, overriding its internal sampling oscillator for as long as a cable is patched here

outputs.text: The bitcrushed signal, mixed with the dry signal by the dry/wet control of the bitcrusher
The decimated signal, mixed with the dry signal by the dry/wet control of the decimator

notes: with nothing patched into the decimator's own input it takes the bitcrusher's output, so one cable into the bitcrusher drives both sections in turn
there is no menu of this module's own beyond Rack's; every setting is on the panel
patching a copy of the input signal into SYNC forces a static waveform, and patching a separate oscillator there gives the bitcrusher equivalent of hard sync
a signal below audio rate at SAMPLE turns the decimator section into a plain sample and hold on its input
